name: Block Breakpoint
description: Adds a per-block third-party setting that shows or hides a block by responsive breakpoint, enforced client-side via a media-query check that removes non-matching blocks from the DOM.
project_description:
The Block Breakpoint module makes it possible to select one or more breakpoints that will apply as a block condition.

 On the rendering of the page an inline script will remove the block, if the selected breakpoint media query does not match the current browser window dimensions. The Javascript MutationObserver ensures, that this also apply on all dynamically added elements, like AJAX or BigPipe.

It adds an "Enable Block Breakpoint" checkbox, a breakpoint-group select and a multi-select of breakpoints to the block configuration form (and Layout Builder component form), stored as third-party settings on the block. At render time the module attaches a media query built from the selected breakpoints and a small JS library that removes the block from the DOM when the query does not match, so external scripts inside a hidden block are never executed. The primary use case is conditional advertisement/embed scripts where CSS hide/show would produce wrong impression statistics.
